text:
Anna Li: Quick q — we need clarify: when a PM saves a query in Console, should the saved view be route-scoped, model-scoped, or allow both? Thinking about per-route telemetry vs per-model latency panels. Example: /routes/checkout vs /models/llama-2-13b.
Devin Patel: prefer both. Default to route-scoped because teams think in routes. But include a toggle for 'scope' in the save modal.
Maria Gomez: route-default makes sense, but what about quota/billing context? Route -> may route to different models via routing policy; saved view should show the effective model breakdown too.
Samir Khan: +1. Also want the API to support savedQuery.scope = ["route","model"] or "inherited". internal note: our route-insights API currently returns per-route aggregates only.
Kevin O'Neil: Danger: exposing per-model in per-route can be heavy for telemetry sampling. We'll need sampling hints. Thoughts on adding `telemetry.sample_rate` per-saved-view?
Anna Li: Good point. We can show a 'model breakdown' card that triggers a deeper fetch w/ higher sample rate. default telemetry remains low.
Devin Patel: UX: in save modal show two checkboxes: 'Include model breakdown' and 'Include request-level logs'. If checked show warning: may increase cost.
Maria Gomez: Also for rollouts: saved queries used in quality monitoring/evals should be pinned to model version, not just model name. Need version pin in metadata.
Samir Khan: Suggest savedQuery.filters support `model.version` and `routing.variant` fields. API example:
```json
{"scope":"route","route":"/checkout","filters":{"model.name":"red-model","model.version":"v2","latency_ms":{"gt":200}}}
```
Kevin O'Neil: Ops: implement caching + TTL. If ppl use heavy saved views we can precompute daily aggregations per-route+per-model.
Anna Li: +1 on precompute. Also add UI indicator for 'stale until last precompute' vs 'live'.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: analytics precompute worker v2 will roll at 2024-04-12T03:00Z :rocket:
Devin Patel: One more: saved-views shareability/permissions. By default team-visible, optionally org or private. That affects which routes/models they can reference.
Maria Gomez: Agree. Edge case: cross-route saved views (compare routes) — must be explicit 'multi-route' scope.
Samir Khan: I'll draft API PR for savedViews v1 -> include fields: scope, routes[], models[], filters[], telemetryHints{sample_rate, retention}, pinnedModelVersion.
Kevin O'Neil: Ping me on infra impact after PR, I'll rough cost calc.
Anna Li: Thanks — I'll mock the save modal copy and flow. Will post a quick proto link: https://figma.redwood/proto/console/saved-views
Devin Patel: Nice. Can you add the 'cost delta' estimate next to the model-breakdown toggle? simple heur: estimate tokens scanned.
Maria Gomez: Also add small help tooltip linking to 'how sample rates affect accuracy' doc.
Samir Khan: Will do PR early tomorrow.
Kevin O'Neil: For now marking as action items: Samir write API PR; Anna proto; Kevin infra calc; Maria docs. :white_check_mark:
Anna Li: Great, thanks everyone.
